env KCLI_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/config

env KCLI_STATE_HOME=$WORK/state

env KCLI_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/cache

# Schema metadata for the command families implemented in later phases.

exec kcli schema show dm reply
stdout '"side_effect": "external-message"'
stdout '"confirmation_required": true'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema show listing get
stdout '"side_effect": "none"'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema show seller get
stdout '"evidence": "provisional"'
! stderr .

exec kcli schema show dm poll
stdout '"side_effect": "account-state"'
! stderr .

# Fail-closed authenticated commands require a session and never open the
# network.

! exec kcli dm poll --since now
stdout '"schema": "kcli.error/v1"'
stdout '"code": "auth_required"'
stderr 'dm poll is list-only; no conversation is opened or marked loaded/read'
stderr 'login is required'

! exec kcli dm reply 123 --message hi --confirm cnf_x
stdout '"code": "auth_required"'
stderr 'dm reply confirm atomically claims local confirmation state and performs at most one external-send attempt'
stderr 'login is required'

exec kcli auth status
stdout '"schema": "kcli.auth/v1"'
! stderr .

# Every resource family parses and renders help without any network.

exec kcli listing get --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli listing get <id-or-url> \[flags\]$'
! stderr .

exec kcli dm reply --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli dm reply <conversation-id> \[flags\]$'
! stderr .

exec kcli auth login --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli auth login \[flags\]$'
! stderr .

exec kcli search --help
stdout '^Usage: kcli search \[<query>\] \[flags\]$'
! stderr .
